title: Ay dilbarane jafare
body:
ay dilbarane jafare tayyar alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
binte ali ye bachon se kehti thi baar baar
ran ko sidharo auno mohamed ye maa nisar
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar ka ifteqar badana jihad mein
nana ki apne shan dikhana jihad mein
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ki beti ke tum dono sher ho
maidan mein jao fatha mein ab kuch na dayr ho
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
har baat apne dil ke siwa ho to baat hai
wo ran pade ke hashr bapa ho to baat hai
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayre rahe sipah magar moo na modna
hyder ki yaadgar ho maidan na chorna
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr o umar ke sar jo utaro to khush hoo mai
dushman ko jhoom jhoom ke maaro to khush hoo mai
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to ye arzoo hai ke tum ran mein kaam aao
chehre ke badle khoon bhare chehre mujhe dikhao
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon zaeef mamu ko zehmat na dijiyo
laashe uthaye bhai to jumbish na kijiyo
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase jo aaoge to sila degi tum ko maa
khud daud kar galay se laga legi maa
ay dilbarane jafare…
author: Zameer Akhtar
